title: English - Teaching Option without Certification
sourceText:
Arts [ARTS]

Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Humanities [HUM]

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Social Sciences [SSCI]

Diversity [DIVR]

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Electives

Electives

American Literature Elective
American Literature Elective: Choose from ENGLISH 210, 368, 371, 372, 470, 480, 481, or 482.

ENGLISH 305 or 306

ENGLISH 326

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Elective

Complete University Writing Portfolio

ENGLISH 325

English or Humanities Electives
English or Humanities Elective: At least one from HUMANITY 101, 103, 302 [M], 303 [M], 304 [M], 335, 350, 410, or 450 is required. Other approved courses include ENGLISH 210, 366, 368, 370, 371, 372, 373, 419, and 480-489 not used to fulfill other major requirements.

Writers from Marginalized Groups Elective
Writers from Marginalized Groups Elective: Choose from ENGLISH 211, 220, 260, 309, 310, 311, 315, 316, 317, 322 [M], 341 [M], 345 [M], 409, or CES 331. Students should consider the University requirement of two [M] courses when selecting course.

ENGLISH 324 [M]

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

300-400-level Electives

ENGLISH 323

Complete Senior Exit Survey

English Literature Elective
English Literature Elective: Choose from ENGLISH 366, 370, 373, 419, 483, 484, 485, 486, 487, 488, 489, HUMANITY 302 [M], 303 [M], 304, 335, 338, 350, 410, or 450.

A student may be admitted to the English – Teaching Option without Certification upon making their intention known to the department. Requirements in this degree include 18 credits of core English Teaching courses and 18 credits of approved electives.
